## Summary
- Shift+click **+A** creates a stereo (2in2out) audio track and forces Equal-Power (`panner_2in2out`) so pan width is live day-to-day.
- Snapshot `track_stereo[]` from `n_inputs().n_audio() >= 2`.
- `--smoke-stereo-track`: at max remove one → add stereo → assert 2in + `pan_width_control` → remove → restore mono count (Dummy exit 0).

## Test plan
- [x] `cmake --build build-win64-gui-engine --config Debug --target airdour_win_shell`
- [x] `win_ardour\run-engine-shell.bat --timeout 8 --backend Dummy --smoke-stereo-track` → exit 0
title: Add stereo audio track with Equal-Power panner
